name: 23947 · Keysville, VA
findings: ZIP 23947 (Keysville) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23947 (Keysville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 23947 (Keysville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).
